title: Canada study permit refusal rate up 4pts in April
body: IRCC data shows SDS stream refusal rate at 56% for Indian applicants, up from 52% previous month. Financial documentation insufficiency cited as primary refusal reason in 61% of refused cases. Recommend reviewing all pending Canadian applications for financial documentation completeness before submission.

title: GTE assessment criteria tightened — new guidance issued
body: DIBP issued updated Genuine Temporary Entrant guidance effective immediately. Key change: increased scrutiny on applicants with immediate family members (parents, siblings, spouse) already in Australia on any visa subclass. Agents must ensure GTE statements specifically address this if applicable.

title: UKVI financial maintenance requirement increased
body: Financial maintenance requirement increased to £1,334/month for London study (from £1,265) and £1,023/month outside London. Effective for applications submitted from 1 June 2026. Update client financial checklists. The 28-day bank statement rule strictly enforced — recent large deposits being flagged.

title: NZ post-study work right extended to 3 years from July
body: Immigration New Zealand confirmed the Graduate visa extension to 3 years will come into effect 1 July 2026 for graduates of NZ universities. This positions NZ more competitively against Australia's 485 visa and Canada's PGWP. Consider updating destination recommendations for clients where PR pathway is primary motivation.

title: AU processing times extended — India offshore applications now averaging 41 days
body: Department of Home Affairs confirms extended processing times for offshore student visa applications. India origin applications averaging 41 days (up from 32 days). Recommend updating client timeline expectations. Applications with complete documentation are being prioritised — ensure all documents submitted at time of lodgement.

title: IRCC provincial study permit allocations released — Ontario cap nearly exhausted
body: IRCC released Q2 2026 provincial allocation data. Ontario DLI cap is 94% utilised. British Columbia at 87%. Agents with clients targeting Ontario or BC universities should assess risk of DLI cap impact before submission. Atlantic provinces remain below 50% utilisation — consider alternative province strategy for strong candidates.

title: Sri Lanka and Nepal applicants seeing elevated UK refusals — 28-31%
body: UKVI compliance data shows elevated refusal rates for Sri Lanka (31%) and Nepal (28%) origin applicants in Q1 2026. Financial evidence quality is primary refusal factor. Ensure maintenance funds comfortably exceed minimum — borderline cases being refused at higher rates than previously. Consider strengthening financial evidence for all pending LK and NP UK applications.

title: INZ processing times improving — now averaging 28 days
body: Immigration New Zealand reports processing time reduction to 28 days average following their digital system upgrade in March. Previous average was 35 days. Online applications continue to be prioritised over paper-based. Positive development for NZ as a destination given competitive positioning vs AU and CA.
